== Notes ==
* If attacking them without conditions, less than one ally in their nearby range and without the use of enchantments, they will never cast Chilbains nor use Signet of Agony (due to the AI behavior regarding those skills) and thus not use Plague Signet. For the level 6 version, their [[Grawl Fighter]] allies will in turn be unable to use [["Victory is Mine!"]].
* The Grawl Necromancer Gear dropped by the level 6 version may be of blue rarity.

==Trivia==
*Before the [[Game updates/20050907|September 7th, 2005]] update, Grawl Crones were called "Grawl Ulodyte."
